text: Hmm, let me think about the refund for a second. I actually have a smart watch and an e-reader that I also want to return. So, ideally, I'd like to return all of them together and get a refund to my credit card. Would that be possible?
zh: 嗯，让我想想退款的事。我实际上还有一块智能手表和一个电子阅读器也想退货。所以，理想情况下，我想把所有这些一起退，并且退到我的信用卡里。这样可能吗？
